Class UserController

java.lang.Object
edu.secourse.patientportal.controller.UserController
@RestController @RequestMapping("/maclogixapi/v1/users") public class UserController extends Object
REST controller responsible for user management operations.

This controller provides endpoints for:

  • Retrieving a single user
  • Retrieving all users
  • Creating new users
  • Updating existing users
  • Deleting users

Base Path: /maclogixapi/v1/users

Security:

  • All endpoints require ADMIN role

Design Notes:

  • Delegates business logic to UserManagementService
  • Uses DTOs (e.g., UserResponse) for safe API responses
  • Supports dynamic updates via request body maps

      @GetMapping("/{username}") @PreAuthorize("hasRole('ADMIN')") public org.springframework.http.ResponseEntity<?> getUser(@PathVariable String username)
      Retrieves a user by username.

      Endpoint: GET /maclogixapi/v1/users/{username}

    • createUser

      @PostMapping("/create") @PreAuthorize("hasRole('ADMIN')") public org.springframework.http.ResponseEntity<?> createUser(@RequestBody Map<String,String> body)
      Creates a new user.

      Endpoint: POST /maclogixapi/v1/users/create

      Expected Request Body: 

      {
  "username": "john123",
  "password": "password123",
  "name": "John Smith",
  "email": "john@mail.com",
  "role": "PATIENT" (PATIENT | DOCTOR | ADMIN)
}

      Behavior:

      • Creates a user object based on the provided role
      • Delegates creation to service layer
      • Returns DTO representation of created user
      Parameters:
      body - request body containing user details
      Returns:
      200 OK with created user, or 400 Bad Request on failure
      Throws:
      RoleNotFoundException - if role is invalid

    • updateUser

      @PutMapping("/{username}") @PreAuthorize("hasRole('ADMIN')") public org.springframework.http.ResponseEntity<?> updateUser(@PathVariable String username, @RequestBody Map<String,String> body)
      Updates an existing user.

      Endpoint: PUT /maclogixapi/v1/users/{username}

      Behavior:

      • Updates only fields provided in request body
      • Delegates update logic to service layer
      Parameters:
      username - the username of the user to update
      body - map containing fields to update
      Returns:
      200 OK if updated, 400 Bad Request otherwise

    • deleteUser

      @DeleteMapping("/{username}") @PreAuthorize("hasRole('ADMIN')") public org.springframework.http.ResponseEntity<?> deleteUser(@PathVariable String username)
      Deletes a user by username.

      Endpoint: DELETE /maclogixapi/v1/users/{username}

      Parameters:
      username - the username of the user to delete
      Returns:
      200 OK if deleted, 404 Not Found if user does not exist, or 500 Internal Server Error if deletion fails
